title: What If a City Banned Cars? Pontevedra Did
subject: pedestrian city

scenes.text: What if a city banned cars from its center? One Spanish city did it in 1999.
Pontevedra pedestrianised its old center in 1999. Motor traffic there fell by 97 percent.
Across the whole city, traffic dropped by 53 percent. Streets became places to walk.
Close to three quarters of former car trips are now made on foot or by bike.
One report says CO2 emissions fell about 70 percent, and traffic deaths nearly vanished.
Meanwhile the center gained about 12,000 residents. The banned cars made room for people.

description:
What if a city banned cars from its center?
Pontevedra in Spain did, and traffic fell 97 percent in the old town.
